theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_sd_good_slice
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (RT : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (RB : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (Ps : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (a b : ℝ), RT.Represents T → Continuous f → a < b → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → AEMeasurable (fun t => (Ps t).massOn W) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (Ps t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * T.massOn W) → (∀ᵐ t, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ps t) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m)) (f ⁻¹' {t}) → Ps t ω = 0) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, Ps t ω = (∫ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m]) → ∃ t ∈ Ioo a b, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ps t) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m)) (f ⁻¹' {t}) → Ps t ω = 0) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, Ps t ω = (∫ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m]) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (b - a) * (Ps t).mass ≤ 2 * ((L : ℝ≥0∞) * RT.measure {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b})
